chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 321: The Four Symbols Formation Trap
chapter_meta_description: Han Li and the Yellow Maple Valley strike team assault the Cold Palace—but the Black Fiend Sect’s Four Symbols Formation forces a brutal resource dilemma. Can Han Li’s preparation turn the tide?
og_description: Liu Jing leads a seven-man assault on the Cold Palace, only to be trapped in an icy illusion formation. Han Li’s secret preparation may be their only way out.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 321 — The Four Symbols Formation
twitter_description: The Black Fiend Sect springs a formation trap on the Yellow Maple Valley squad. Brute force will cost them the war—Han Li has a quieter plan.

lore_anchors.definition: A defensive array derived from the Four Celestial Symbols (Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, Black Tortoise) from ancient Chinese astronomy, used here to trap enemies in a disorienting icy illusion realm.
A legendary minor forbidden array excelling at illusion and concealment; Han Li set this up the previous night as a strategic asset.
A signature wide-area attack technique of the Blue Silk Sword, releasing countless fine blue threads to pierce multiple enemies simultaneously.
Historically, a secluded area of the imperial palace where disfavored royal women were confined; here repurposed as the Black Fiend Sect’s stronghold.
The second major cultivation stage, representing the solid foundation for advanced magic; these cultivators are exempt from menial duties and have access to high-grade tools.
